top_paper.title: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
top_paper.summary: LoopArena benchmarks how well a controller model guides a separate coding agent through long tasks, revealing low strict success rates and significant cost reductions.

papers.title: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? From Noisy Teacher to Self-Improvement
papers.summary: On-policy distillation relies mainly on suppressing low-probability tokens rather than teacher guidance, motivating a supervision-free entropy-adaptive method that substantially improves reasoning performance.

papers.title: PaperGym: Rubric-Centered Evolution for Research-Plan Generation
papers.summary: PaperGym converts scientific papers into training environments by separating research questions from evaluation rubrics, enabling reinforcement learning that improves research planning across multiple model sizes.

papers.title: Cross-lingual Functional Vectors for Emotion Detection in Large Language Models
papers.summary: Function vectors extracted from one language improve multilingual emotion recognition by capturing language-independent task signals and reducing inference overhead.

papers.title: Ask or Answer: A Decision Framework for Multi-Turn Health Misinformation Intervention
papers.summary: RO-PnR learns when to ask clarifying questions versus deliver corrections by weighing interaction costs against expected gains, improving cost-adjusted outcomes in health misinformation dialogues.

papers.title: Acquire, Repair, Preserve: A Diagnosis-Guided Post-Training Recipe for Small-Model Dialogue Game Agents
papers.summary: A 2B open-weight model improves interactive dialogue-game performance through supervised fine-tuning and turn-local preference training, though gains remain largely within the targeted game family.

papers.title: EvoUndo: Recoverability-Constrained Self-Evolution for LLM Agent Harnesses
papers.summary: EvoUndo evaluates recoverability of self-modifying LLM agents and shows that reliable recovery requires co-designing verification, state grounding, and recovery-language expressivity.

papers.title: Generative Semantic Scene Completion
papers.summary: Generative discrete diffusion recasts outdoor LiDAR semantic scene completion via paired sparse-dense synthesis, semantic-guided generation, and structured refinement to achieve state-of-the-art results.

papers.title: Sliding-window beats linear attention
papers.summary: Sliding window attention with sinks outperforms post-trained linear attention on long-context tasks without requiring retraining, offering a cheaper and more reliable inference solution.

papers.title: Lost in Compression: A Controlled Cross-Lingual Audit of Extractive Prompt Compressors
papers.summary: Learned prompt compressors trained on English data disproportionately degrade non-English contexts, widening token-cost disparities, while multilingual training and deterministic methods reduce this gap.

papers.title: Act with Intent: Distilling Behavior Intent for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can turn multimodal context into robot actions, but their action decoders are still trained largely by behavior cloning. This supervises which motor command was demonstrated while leaving implicit the local objective served by the behavior under the instruction. Future-based supervision enriches action learning with frames, latent observations, trajectories, or motion representations, but these signals capture particular realizations of what may happen rather than the shared semantic objective of the forthcoming behavior. papers.title: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
papers.summary: LoopArena benchmarks how well a controller model guides a separate coding agent through long tasks, revealing low strict success rates and significant cost reductions.

papers.title: GGSS: Geodesic-Gated Spherical Steering for Inference-Time Debiasing of Generative Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: GGSS reduces demographic bias in generative vision-language models by steering visual tokens along geodesic arcs with an adaptive gate, preserving visual-language accuracy.

papers.title: Language Chain in Alignment: Cross-lingual Ranking Preference Optimization
papers.summary: Cross-lingual Ranking Preference Optimization improves multilingual alignment by transferring English preference knowledge to target languages through hierarchical ranking optimization.

papers.title: Agentic Artifact Creation: Systems, Evaluation, Principles, and Opportunities
papers.summary: This survey defines agentic artifact creation as stateful, feedback-driven construction of deliverables by AI systems and analyzes 259 works across artifact families, settings, and evaluation practices to propose principles for accountable control.

papers.title: DART-SD: Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
papers.summary: DART-SD improves multi-turn tool-calling agents by modeling execution as a diamond-topology graph, identifying critical failure points, and applying localized self-distillation to preserve valid reasoning while correcting errors.

papers.title: Locate Anything in Videos: Rethinking Efficient Generative Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
papers.summary: Parallel Tube Decoding enables simultaneous spatial and temporal video grounding by removing autoregressive dependencies, drastically cutting latency while improving accuracy.

papers.title: Fast Weight Attention for Continual Learning
papers.summary: Recurrent fast-weight memories and selective state-space models are analyzed as online learning rules under autoregressive semantics, yielding normalized update families with stable renormalization that improve length extrapolation.

papers.title: Ring Forcing: Towards Precise Long-Term Memory for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.summary: Ring Forcing is an autoregressive video diffusion framework that improves long-term memory through ring-structured training, history compression, and sparse rotary embeddings to achieve minute-long coherence.

papers.title: LayerRecall: A State-Conditioned Memory Router for Long-Horizon Consistency in Video Generation
papers.summary: LayerRecall selectively routes long-range historical memory into specific video diffusion layers to improve long-video consistency, supervised by cross-horizon prediction matching.

papers.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090
papers.summary: A cost-efficient open-source pretraining recipe trains 2B-parameter models on consumer GPUs for under $7K, yielding performance near larger baselines while deriving cost scaling laws and studying data curricula.

papers.title: Paint What You See: Benchmarking Dexterous Visual Tool Use in Multimodal Agents
papers.summary: EASEL benchmarks fine-grained visual tool use through reference-guided reconstruction and semantic tasks, revealing that current multimodal agents struggle with closed-loop precision and trajectory stability.

papers.title: StarHarness: Evolving Harnesses with Stratified Search for Enterprise Environments
papers.summary: StarHarness evolves fixed-weight agent harnesses via stratified task pools and hidden selection to improve enterprise tool-use performance and cross-model transfer.

papers.title: J-Zero: Unified Challenger--Solver--Judge Co-Evolution from Zero Data
papers.summary: J-Zero enables self-improving language models across verifiable and unverifiable domains through adversarial co-evolution of a task generator, solver, and judge using predefined preference pairs.

papers.title: Revisiting Local Context for Long-Horizon Streaming 3D Reconstruction
papers.summary: ABot-Recon achieves stable long-horizon streaming 3D reconstruction by using only local temporal context and frame-independent predictions composed sequentially, reducing drift via a lightweight temporal refiner and composition-aware pose loss.

papers.title: StepGuard: Learning Step-Level Guardrails with Scalable Supervision and Safety-Utility Balancing
papers.summary: StepGuard is a step-level guard model that audits agent actions before execution, trained via automatic trajectory generation and balanced reinforcement learning to reduce attacks with minimal utility loss.

papers.title: Rubric-to-Code Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: RCCA improves reinforcement learning for interactive web app generation by assigning localized credit to code regions based on rubric-level feedback, yielding substantial benchmark gains.

papers.title: Video Generative Models as Geometry Learner
papers.summary: GeoNeXt repurposes pretrained video generative models as a unified framework for geometry estimation via next-frame prediction, enabling efficient joint modeling of depth and surface normals with minimal labeled data.

papers.title: LMSM: LLM Security Framework Inspired by Linux Security Modules
papers.summary: LMSM applies a modular security framework to LLM serving by separating evidence calibration, policy evaluation, and output gating, enabling flexible interpretability-based enforcement without rebuilding request handling.

papers.title: Training, learning and inference: unified dynamics of neural systems
papers.summary: Atomic generation facts compiled into a graph enable recursive scientific processes, and training-learning dynamics in nanoGPT are characterized by state-conditioned parameter updates, persistent functional reorganization, and frozen inference projections validated across architectures.

papers.title: Beyond Data Scaling: Representation-Centric Continued Pre-training for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary: VLAct improves vision-language-action model performance by pre-training on diverse robot data with preserved vision-language priors and shared action semantics, achieving strong results across simulations and unseen embodiments with limited compute.
